title: Volunteer Event Sign-In Log
subtitle: Capture service role, shift, site lead, and task boundary; confirm equipment and hours confirmation.
description: Volunteer Event records service role, shift, site lead, task boundary, equipment, and hours confirmation. Volunteer Event evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this volunteer event attendance and custody reconciliation when staff must document service role and shift. Reconcile site lead, task boundary, equipment, and hours confirmation before the volunteer event handoff. Use the role description, shift roster, site-lead brief, safety equipment issue, task completion sheet, break record, hours verification, and departure log. This record assigns a service contributor to a nonprofit or community shift with a task brief, site supervisor, tools, protective equipment, break coverage, verified hours, and service exit. Ask the assigned volunteer event reviewer to confirm service role against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Volunteer Event details
sections.guidance: Assign service role, shift, site lead, task boundary, tool or protective equipment, breaks, accessibility route, completed hours, and departure.

sections.title: Volunteer Event roster identity, check-in, assignment, and departure
sections.guidance: Match each person to the accepted registration, credential, role or session, and departure status.

blocks.label: Volunteer Event roster boundary
blocks.guidance: Route any unmatched registration, credential, role, session, or departure to its named owner before closing the roster.

sections.title: Volunteer Event roster outcome and reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile expected, checked-in, departed, and unresolved roster entries.

blocks.label: Volunteer Event log receipt

fields.label: Event coordinator or roster custodian and date

blocks.guidance: Do not close an unreconciled entry without a named owner.
